g.text: Michaelis–Menten kinetics pass from first-order substrate response toward saturation
Hypothetical enzyme system at fixed total enzyme concentration and temperature, under Michaelis–Menten assumptions. Dashed tangent is the low-substrate
limiting response, not valid over the full concentration range. K_m is a kinetic parameter and is not universally equal to the enzyme–substrate
